fullPassage: Surely one reason that copies have lost their sense of human connection, abundance, and intimate relation is that modern technology has made copying so easy. The methods of copying available to us have never been more powerfully abundant. This seems true even as a sense of loss has attended our ever more powerful means to reproduce what we care about. Walter Benjamin has famously formulated this loss as an "aura": that which is lost in mechanical reproduction. The aura of a work of art, he suggests, cannot be copied by mechanical technology. By around 1900, he writes, "technical reproduction had reached a standard that not only permitted it to reproduce all transmitted works of art and thus to cause the most profound change in their impact upon the public." The ability to copy mechanically "substituted a plurality of copies for a unique existence," Benjamin argued. In addition to transforming art and the public's relation to it, Benjamin asserted that mechanical reproduction has the power to rend traditions by interfering with the authority of objects "embedded in the fabric of tradition." This devotion to tradition was twofold and concerned the presence of objects, Benjamin believed.

This devotion to tradition was twofold and concerned the presence of objects, Benjamin believed.

questions.passage:
(A) The textile <u>fabric</u> used for the curtains was a rich, deep blue velvet imported from Italy.
(B) Benjamin asserted that mechanical reproduction has the power to rend traditions by interfering with the authority of objects embedded in the <u>fabric</u> of tradition.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 fabric의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fabric: (A) 실제 직물 (커튼용 벨벳) / (B) 전통의 구조/짜임 (비유적 표현)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 구조 — (B) 직물: (A)는 구조가 아닌 실제 직물, (B)는 직물이 아닌 비유적 구조
❌ ② (A) 옷감 — (B) 겉면: (B)의 fabric of tradition은 겉면이 아닌 내적 구조/짜임
❌ ③ (A) 직물 — (B) 직물: (B)에서 fabric은 실제 직물이 아닌 전통의 비유적 구조
✅ ④ (A) 직물 — (B) 구조/짜임: (A)는 커튼용 실제 직물, (B)는 전통의 구조/짜임이라는 비유적 의미 ←정답
det.tip: fabric: ① (물리적) 직물/천 ② (비유적) 구조/짜임 — the fabric of tradition은 전통의 내적 구조

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to express or state something in a clear and definite way"

det.korean: formulate=공식화하다/명확히 진술하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① reproduce: reproduce(복제하다)는 무엇인가를 다시 만드는 것이지 명확히 진술하는 것이 아님
❌ ② interfere: interfere(간섭하다)는 다른 것에 개입하는 것으로 진술과 무관
❌ ③ substitute: substitute(대체하다)는 하나를 다른 것으로 바꾸는 것으로 진술과 무관
✅ ④ formulate: formulate(공식화하다)는 명확하고 분명한 방식으로 표현/진술하는 것으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: formulate = 공식화하다, 명확히 진술하다. Benjamin has formulated this loss as an aura
